items.content_html: A lightweight proxy/browser extension that sits between employees and any AI tool. It intercepts prompts in real-time, uses a small local LLM to detect sensitive data (PII, source code, financials), and redacts/masks it on the fly instead of blocking , then un-masks the AI's response. Employee still gets their answer; company data never leaves.

items.content_html: Ferric SSH is a lightweight, fast, and modern desktop SSH client. The backend is powered by a pure-Rust protocol stack — russh / russh-sftp — so it does not shell out to the system ssh binary. The frontend is built with React 19 + Tailwind CSS and packaged as a native desktop app via Tauri.
